overview.name: American Century Securitized Credit ETF
overview.description: The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in securitized credit investments. It generally intends to focus on investment grade, U.S. securitized debt securities in non-traditional asset-backed sectors (such as aircraft leases, equipment leases, consumer loans, cell towers, and digital infrastructure). The fund will invest primarily in U.S. dollar-denominated securities.
